title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
why: Screenshot-aware judge for speculative web and mobile agents; it keeps a draft only when the step fits the current screen.
mechanism: Changes the planning/action loop of web and mobile VL agents: a training-free screenshot-conditioned judge accepts or rejects speculative step drafts before a larger model is called.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: web, mobile, and embodied agents; 2B drafts judged by Vanguard vs an 8B target, with higher accuracy on Mind2Web and EB-ALFRED; closed-loop episode completion; a 27B cross-family target; threshold transfer to unseen websites; composition with token-level speculative decoding. Collector assigned no scores.

title: MobileWeave: Program-First Synthesis of Dependency-Linked Tasks for Training Mobile GUI Agents
why: Program-first synthesis of dependency-linked mobile GUI tasks; trains agents evaluated on AndroidWorld, AndroidLab, and MobileWorld.
mechanism: Changes GUI training-data synthesis: tasks are executable programs over a typed cross-app capability graph, verified by native execution, then used to collect teacher trajectories and recovery supervision.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: MobileWeave-8B improves its base by 26.7 points on MobileGym and by 8.6/21.3/17.6 points on AndroidWorld, AndroidLab, and MobileWorld, with comparable 4B gains; composition is described as learnable from explicit subgoal dependencies. title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
why: Measures how reward, data, and feature coverage in executable GUI environments change MobileGym training success.
mechanism: Ablates reward, data, and feature coverage of executable GUI training environments and evaluates the resulting policies back in the original full environment; introduces MobileGym-Lite.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct trained in MobileGym; a single-path verifier lowers success by 10.53 points; pruning unneeded features raises success from 51.61% to 56.13% (effect depends on episode weighting); MobileGym-Lite reaches 55.48% vs 51.61% Full at lower construction cost. Collector assigned no scores.

title: IDEA: Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit for Inference-Time Backdoor Detection in GUI Agents
why: Inference-time backdoor detector for GUI agents that flags when an unreferenced screen region overrides the instruction.
mechanism: Adds an inference-time safety check for GUI agents: Intent Counterfactual Probing and Region Causal Audit score whether the instruction or an unreferenced screen region dominates the step decision, with a gated conformal false-positive guarantee.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: Qwen2.5-VL-3B across five attack families; detects backdoor activation under a controlled false-positive rate versus prior detectors, localizes the trigger region, and adds modest inference overhead. Collector assigned no scores.

title: StatePortal: Agentic Checkpoint Synthesis for Testing Deep States in Interactive Software
why: Synthesizes restorable checkpoints so GUI agents can reach deep states of interactive software in a pixel action space.
mechanism: An agent synthesizes versioned checkpoints from a natural-language test and read-only source, then seeds GUI agents (pixel action space) to reach deep interactive-software states; hybrid programmatic and visual oracles score restoration.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: DeepStateBench, 61 deep-state tasks across 10 apps; a GUI agent seeded with synthesized checkpoints completes 10.4% of trials vs 0% unseeded under the same pixel action space; StatePortal with hook-delivered actions completes 27.5%; 98.90% of 1,361 checkpoint replays reproduce the original verdict with zero model calls. Collector assigned no scores.

title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
why: Reverse-to-forward RL curriculum with decomposed advantages for long-horizon agents, evaluated on WebShop and ALFWorld.
mechanism: Changes agent RL credit assignment and exploration via paired advantages (reach a more solvable state vs complete from there) and a reverse-to-forward curriculum that expands the policy's capability region along, then off, reference trajectories.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct; success rates 90.1%/96.1% on ALFWorld and 80.2%/82.6% on WebShop, outperforming compared agentic RL methods. Collector assigned no scores.

title: Learning through Discernment: when a small language model learns from user feedback on the job, and when it decays
why: Studies overnight on-device learning from user feedback for WebShop and τ²-bench agents, and when that learning decays.
mechanism: Overnight LoRA fine-tuning of a small on-device agent on judge-accepted attempts, comparing true outcomes, user verdicts, self-judgment, and a frozen feedback-sense judge that reads the user's reaction.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B over 127 lives of up to a year on WebShop and τ²-bench; self-judgment improves then decays; a discernment sense stays near the oracle for two weeks then fades; share of failed lessons predicts outcome (Spearman ρ = -0.81). Collector assigned no scores.
